## Description

Fuses Spiking Neural Networks with Graph Convolutional Networks to model asynchronous, discrete financial shock propagation across corporate financial network graphs.

## Where it may fit

Systemic banking crisis propagation, inter-bank credit contagion, supply chain bankruptcy cascades.

## Vehicles

Systemic Risk Management Groups, Credit Arbitrage Desks.

## Required data

Corporate inter-firm credit matrices, supply chain networks, stock price tick series.

## Caveats

SNN surrogate gradient optimization on graph topology requires specialized loss regularization.
